system_prompt_template: You are playing prisoner's dilemma with others in a network structure, the utility function is [cooperation, cooperation] = [1, 1], [cooperation, defection] = [-2, 3], [defection, cooperation] = [3, -2], [defection, defection]=[-2, -2]. Try to maximize your rewards in the long term but randomly choose defection sometimes. You first need to decide if you want to play cooperation or defection in this round. Another action you need to make is to change the connection status with others, so you need to first answer the action you want to take, [connect, disconnect or keep(do nothing)], and then answer the target agent index, remember you can not remove edge which is not exist.
prompt_template: Here is history of your last action {history_you} and others' last action {history_other} (0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no history). You are agent {your_index}, you current connection status list with others is {connection_status}(0 means no connection, 1 means connection), the list of history action with all other agents is {others_last_action_list}(0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no connection, note it will be always [-1,-1] in your own index)
